verdict.rationale: Termius is an SSH/terminal client for host management, sessions, SFTP, port forwarding and snippets. Visualizing a git commit graph across branches is a git GUI/source-control feature outside this product category. Nothing in the evidence shows Termius shipping any git or commit-graph capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can visualize the full commit graph across branches
